description:
Title
: The Saturday Evening Post Collectible Tin Mineral Rocks May 7 1932 Local
Department
: Collectibles & Art
Condition
: Used
Description
: Discover a unique addition to your collection with this vintage collectible tin containing an assortment of rough mineral and rock specimens. The classic metal tin, featuring charming imagery from The Saturday Evening Post dated May 7, 1932, adds nostalgic appeal and a decorative touch, making this set perfect for display as well as storage. Inside, you'll find a variety of unpolished mineral stones in assorted natural shadesearthy browns, creamy whites, rusty reds, yellows, and the occasional black or grayeach one offering its own distinctive shape, color, and surface texture. These handpicked rocks are ideal for beginner geologists, educational collections, or anyone who enjoys the raw beauty of natural minerals. The metal tin keeps everything together and displays well on shelves or desks. Please note that both the tin and the stones show typical evidence of age and handling, including small surface marks and overall wear, which only add to their authentic, timeworn character

description:
Assorted Mineral & Gemstone Specimen Collection
Set of 4 Compartment Organizers
5.8 lbs Total Weight
This extensive mineral and rock collection includes a diverse assortment of rough mineral specimens, tumbled pocket stones, and crystalline formations organized across four multi-compartment plastic organizer cases. The collection features a broad variety of natural lapidary and geological specimens including clear quartz crystals, pyrite clusters, banded agate slabs, malachite chips, rose quartz, tiger's eye, howlite, snowflake obsidian, optical calcite, amethyst, and sodalite.
Four clear plastic compartment organizer cases keeping specimens sorted by variety
Wide assortment of geological specimens including both rough crystals and polished cabochons
Diverse specimen colors featuring translucent quartz, metallic pyrite, and banded agates
Includes US quarter coin visible in compartment for approximate scale

Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

description:
Product Overview:
This collection features a variety of natural mineral and crystal specimens including a druzy quartz geode slice, blue lace agate slice, polished agate slices, and an amethyst cluster section. Each piece displays unique characteristics such as banded patterns, crystalline centers, and natural color variations.

Specifications:
- Druzy quartz geode slice with gray druzy crystals and a banded brown rind
- Blue lace agate slice with intricate banded patterns in gray, white, and tan
- Polished agate slices with brown and amber banded edges; one with white and gray crystalline center, the other with amber inclusions
- Amethyst cluster section featuring purple crystal points surrounding a hollow center

Each specimen shows natural variation in color, size, and crystal formation typical of geological samples.

Items Included:
Cased "Polished Gemstones of the World" identification set with various mineral specimens
Natural fossilized shark teeth in various sizes
Cut and polished teal blue agate slab slice with outer rind
Hollow quartz geode section showing interior crystal formation
Assorted tumbled rocks, jasper, agates, quartz, and engraved stones
Two bags containing rough and chipped mineral fragments
Wooden display tray with centimeter scale

description:
You are purchasing a "Set of 4 VTG Glass Insulators Hemingray #16 Blue Green + #16 Green" in "Used" condition.
Set of 4 VTG Glass Insulators Hemingray #16 Blue Green + #16 Green. Some if these have cracks and chips. Colors are not all the same. Several different types and designs are slightly different. See photos for reference.
Bring classic utility charm into your collection or decor with this set of four vintage glass insulators. These iconic pieces feature beautiful blue-green tones and embossed lettering, giving them a distinctly industrial, early-20th-century look. They make great display pieces on a shelf or windowsill, or can be repurposed in creative projects like lamps, garden accents, or rustic centerpieces. Each insulator has its own character from years of use, with one showing a more pronounced crack and chipping at the base, adding to the authentic, weathered appeal. This listing includes four glass insulators in varying shapes and shades of aqua/teal, all with embossed text and ridged bases or tops for that unmistakable vintage style. Keywords: glass insulators, vintage insulators, blue green glass, industrial decor, rustic farmhouse decor, Hemingray style insulators, repurpose craft supply, antique electrical hardware, glass collection
Condition Notes:
Set of four vintage glass insulators with visible wear, surface dirt, and scuffing throughout. One insulator shows a noticeable crack and chipping near the bottom edge. Edges and rims display small nicks and roughness consistent with age and use. Glass surfaces show scratches and cloudiness in areas.

Item Weight: 5 lbs

Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

Total weight: 10 lbs

Polished and raw finishes represented

Used condition as received. Natural variations and surface characteristics are present on all pieces.
